The '''Anarrian Empire''' was a country on the western continent of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altiria/Anarris]], in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Formed around the time of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] and most of Altiria/Anarris'. The empire sought to gain dominance over the [[Altiri/Legends|Altiri]], a rival species of the Anarrians.
